intent: Simple semantic table for invoices, lists, and text rows, with optional sort, row menu, sticky header and loading, empty and error states. Search and filters belong on DataTable. One piece.
useWhen: Listing invoices, products, or other short text rows
Inside Section on dashboard or list-detail patterns
doNotUseWhen: Search, filters, selection, or column settings — use DataTable
Usage against a plan limit — use UsageList

columns.note: numeric or align end right-aligns the column and its header (a sortable number header keeps its icon on the right). emphasis or the first column is medium + text-primary. sortable makes the header a button: ascending, descending, then off (local state only). sortValue returns what to sort by (numbers and Dates compare numerically, strings locale-aware); without it, a numeric column sorts by the digits in its text and others by text. sortValue is a function, so build the columns in a client component.

rows.note: Values render in native td. Plain strings and numbers, or ReactNode such as kit Cell (badge, avatar, link) or Badge. The first column's text (or its Cell label) names the row.

caption.note: Renders below the grid (caption-side bottom). Not a heading above the table.

size.note: md rows and header are 40px, one line. sm a hair tighter, lg a hair roomier. Do not recreate DataTable 3–4rem rows.

emptyLabel.note: Shown as a small Empty (kind no-data) in one td with colSpan when rows is empty or state is empty. Say why it is empty.

footer.note: Renders tfoot one row: label in a td colSpan={columns.length-1}, value in last td end-aligned.

stickyHeader.note: The header row stays in view while the body scrolls. Give the Table a height (style or className) so the region scrolls.

rowActions.note: (row, index) => CellAction[]. One row menu (Cell type actionMenu) in a last 56px column with no visible header text, named Actions for <first cell>. Return [] to leave a row without a menu.

rowActionsAs.note: menu: one row menu (Cell actionMenu). icons: each action as an icon-only ghost Button (Cell actionIcons, up to 3), named by its ariaLabel, like Edit Onboarding part 2 of 3, 15 Dec. Use icons for one or two row actions the person scans for; the column stays 56px with no visible header text, so footer totals stay under their column.

state.note: loading: header stays, rows are Skeleton bars, region aria-busy. empty: Empty with emptyLabel. error: LoadError with errorMessage and onRetry. Without state, rows render (and rows=[] is empty).

errorMessage.note: state error: what failed, named, like Couldn’t load invoices.

onRetry.note: () => void. state error: shows the Try again Button.

stack.note: Opt-in. Below 480px (container width) each row stacks into two lines: the first column and the last number column on top, the other columns below in small muted text. Headers stay for screen readers.

rowHref.note: (row, index) => string. The first cell becomes a link to the row. With stack, the whole stacked row is the link target; the row menu stays its own control.

requirements: Column headers in thead with th scope=col
Optional caption describes the table and sits below
Empty state is one td with colSpan=columns.length and emptyLabel
Optional footer is tfoot with label spanning leading columns and value end-aligned
Narrow container keeps column min-width and scrolls horizontally; the scroller is a focusable region
Sortable th has aria-sort none | ascending | descending; the header label is a native button, so Enter and Space sort
Row menu column th has visually hidden text Actions; each menu is named Actions for <first cell>
state loading sets aria-busy on the region; state empty is role=status; state error is role=alert with Try again
With stack, headers stay in the table for screen readers; the row link is a real link in the first cell

doNot: Do not invent TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, or TableCaption cousins
Do not compose HeaderCell — header cells stay on DataTable. Cell is fine in rows
Do not squash columns to the container — overflow-x on the wrapper
Do not build usage rows from a Table with a Progress column — use UsageList
Do not put a second menu or icon buttons in a row — one rowActions menu, last
Do not make stack the default — it is opt-in
Do not sort currency or date strings lexically — give the column sortValue
snippet: <Table caption="A list of your recent invoices." columns={[{ key: 'invoice', header: 'Invoice', emphasis: true, sortable: true }, { key: 'status', header: 'Status' }, { key: 'method', header: 'Method' }, { key: 'amount', header: 'Amount', numeric: true, align: 'end', sortable: true }]} rows={[{ invoice: 'INV001', status: 'Paid', method: 'Credit Card', amount: '$250.00' }]} footer={{ label: 'Total', value: '$2,500.00' }} emptyLabel="No results." />
